name: You Me VirUS
source:
"You are Influenza and this season has not been good for you. The common cold is getting way higher ratings of infection on Instagerm. Wanting to show your superiority, you find a wealthy, eligible socialite to trick into falling in love with you and spreading your disease. But will you choose the party princ(ess) instead?
